## What's free

Personal plan: 10 connections, 100 subscriptions, 10 GB data transfer and 5 GB JetStream storage, 2 accounts, 1 MB max message

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.synadia.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

nats-io/jetstream manages streams, consumers and KV buckets on any NATS server, including Synadia Cloud. Accounts and users are managed in the Synadia console.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
